summary: Three serious axe violations on /start/ (color-contrast on .footnote, link-in-text-block on two inline anchors). These are pre-existing issues on a page CLV-29 does not modify; resolution likely requires either the .footnote text/link styling on /start/ or extending the axe.ignored allowlist in the UI review config.

Either restyle .footnote on the /start/ page or allowlist this rule+target in .cloverleaf/config/ui-review-config.json axe.ignored.
/start/ — link 'Chapter 7 of the guide' is not visually distinguishable from surrounding text without color. Pre-existing; same scope considerations as the color-contrast finding.
/start/ — external 'repository' anchor is not visually distinguishable from surrounding text without color. Pre-existing.
